title: A recorded auto-resolution decision survives a doctor drift-repair clobber
retires: F-CLASS-09 (sticky auto-resolution clobbered); R4 append-only decisions
notes: GREEN: doctor neutralized on the contracted path (applied=false record) and the ledger projection reports the recorded pass. RED: no record; the doctor applies the stale node_results drift over the pass. gate_replay mode: the driver exercises the REAL scheduler/dispatcher/ledger seams inside the sandbox HARNESS_DIR.
